items.title: F5 (FFIV) Launches AI Fleet Management To Speed BIG IP Security Fixes
items.summary: F5 (NasdaqGS:FFIV) has introduced AI driven fleet management capabilities in F5 Insight for ADSP. The new features are designed to help enterprises address security vulnerabilities in BIG-IP environments more quickly. The update focuses on AI automation, governance and auditability for large scale application security deployments. items.title: FFIV Q2 Deep Dive: AI Demand and Hybrid Cloud Tailwinds Drive Results, Margin Outlook Cautious
items.summary: Application security provider F5 (NASDAQ:FFIV) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.9% year on year to $865.1 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $880 million at the midpoint, 2.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.73 per share was 18.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: F5 (NASDAQ:FFIV) Beats Expectations in Strong Q2 CY2026, Next Quarter’s Sales Guidance is Optimistic
items.summary: Application security provider F5 (NASDAQ:FFIV) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.9% year on year to $865.1 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $880 million at the midpoint, 2.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.73 per share was 18.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
